release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.3.1 — Production Release:
• Hardened Restriction Engine: Instant Home-minimize and foreground FocusDefend interception stops pass-through.
• Service Resiliency: AlarmManager resurrection prevents termination on swipe from Recents.
• Interactive Deep Study Mode: +2 focus points per minute, ambient glow pulse timer, subject selector, pause/skip freedom.
• Regain Flexible Study Schedule: Morning, Afternoon, Evening focus blocks with skip flexibility.
• 1,500+ CBSE/ICSE Question Integration: Curriculum questions loaded with formulas and explanations.
• Parent-Child Connection with Invite Code: Instant pairing, live wellbeing telemetry & 7-Week Wellbeing Reports.
• AI Digital Wellbeing Engine: Auto-shuffles app priority and dynamically modifies credit costs during study hours.
• Apple Squircle UI: Concentric 32px squircles, dual-rim specular highlights, zero Bitcoin logos.
